cards.title: The arrive dock option
cards.does: Names how the card arrives: the spring pop (the default), a stop-action throw, or a landing.

options.means: Arrival material (paper | metal | liquid | ink): The material preset a throw or a landing settles by.

lives.note: throwXf / landXf (inlined) + engine arriveOf (needs kinetics stop_action)

callable.why: probe OK; the throw/land paints only when the build turns kinetics stop_action on (arriveOf)

cards.title: The badge rail
cards.does: A qualification stamps onto a rail one at a time: on a held card at each `badge_at[i]` (2.05 s after it lands, then 1.30 s apart), or on a ledger page's own rail from `page.badges[]` after the build.
cards.when: the claim on screen needs its qualifications said one clause at a time - the callout is the conclusion, so a badge keying a chart waits for the draw

author.key: `badge_at[]` on the dock entry (the compiler's `dock_entry` from the evidence card's `badges`); `page.badges[]` on a ledger page - no shot-row token of its own

lives.note: a card's pills light at d.badge_at[i], floored at the chart's draw-complete; a page's rail springs each badge in over LP_BADGE_IN on the LP_BADGE_STEP ladder; compiler dock_entry / badges_for

doctrine: E45 (the dock choreography that lands the rail)

callable.why: implicit: the compiler writes badge_at for every dock whose evidence carries badges (Steel: 41 of 43)

cards.title: The behind-the-plate dock option
cards.does: The plate's own foreground cutout paints over the card, so the card sits in the room behind a real object - depth by occlusion, not blur.

lives.note: render: the `fgD` foreground pass (`(sc.docks || []).find((d) => d && d.fg ...)`); compiler plate_layers / behind_error

callable.why: probe OK; the plate must declare the layer

cards.title: The centred dock option

aliases.name: A centred dock in an AUTHORED box

cards.does: The card sits centred on the page in an authored or computed box, clear of the page's ink, instead of the dock slot; without `read` it holds that box from its first frame.
cards.when: the card must sit where the page's ink leaves room and the sentence rings a number ON the card's chart

options.means: Card aspect: The card's height over its width, so the centred box is the card's own shape.
Centred band: Which free band of the page (above, right, left, below, foot) the centred card takes.
Centred width: The centred card's width as a share of the stage (0.05-1.0).
Centred x: The card's centre as a share of the stage width.
Centred y: The card's centre as a share of the stage height.

lives.note: centred_place / solo_centre_by_clock (the player paints the compiled `place` box via dockGeom)

cards.title: The cutout dock option
cards.does: Asks for the cutout dock kind (no card, paper, border or rail).

lives.note: `{'cutout': True}` -> the dock's kind: cutout (no card, no paper, no border - a head above the crawl); refused with press, stack, embed and fit (R26-94, fixed 2026-09-13)

cards.title: The dock at a depth

aliases.name: the docks move through the depth

cards.does: The card stands on a layer's plane and takes that share of the ONE camera's move, instead of standing still in screen space while the world moves behind it.
cards.when: Only under a move the frame can already name (E59) and on a plate that ships in planes: parallax is a consequence of the camera in a layered world, never a move authored to show depth off (E49).

author.key: dock option {'depth': <k>} (0..4 - kinetics/camera.mjs PARALLAX, the page's own range and words)

lives.note: the dock paint's own prefix (dockCam / dockDepthOf, beside embedCam); the compiler half is DOCK_DEPTH / dock_depth_k / dock_depth_behind_error, read by dock_opts

callable.why: probe OK; it moves only under an authored camera move, and `behind=` composes with it up to the occluder's own plane (1.40)

cards.title: The art-embed surface dock option

aliases.name: it should read as inside of the TV

cards.does: The card lands ON a surface the plate declares, projected onto its four corners; a bare still or clip COVERS its surface by default, while a card carrying badges, a record, a chart or proofs stays a reflowed card (E95).
cards.when: a press quote or a record lands in the ART world - on the poster, the TV, the laptop, the paper of an approved plate; never a chart.

phases.name: enter
phases.does: a throw lands onto the plane with its own impact; any other arrival fades up in place

phases.name: darken
phases.does: the room outside the surface dims on one min-jerk move, the surface itself kept clear

phases.name: hold
phases.does: the card holds on the surface carrying its own idle about its centre (E49)

phases.name: screen
phases.does: on a SCREEN the plate's light returns over the card, the bezel falls off, the paper lifts; on a paper the card casts a small shadow
phases.trigger: surface kind (declared, or the name matches EMBED_SCREEN)

blends.source: Bravos's TV world (their claims on a monitor in a lit studio)

options.means: Picture fit on a surface (cover | contain): A still or clip on a surface fills the surface's whole box (cover) or letterboxes on the screen's own dark (contain) - no paper, masthead or rail.
Contain: The picture is letterboxed inside the surface on the screen's own dark ground (EMBED_FILL_GROUND #05131e).
Cover: fills the whole surface box, cropped - the DEFAULT for a bare still or clip (E95); a card with badges, a record, a chart or a stack never covers, it reflows
Paper surface (the default kind): The card LIES on the surface (a poster, a washi sheet, a paper on a desk) with its own small shadow.
Screen surface: The surface DISPLAYS the card: the plate's own light comes back over it, the bezel's inner edge falls off, the card's paper lifts toward the light.
A surface as a camera target: A camera move takes a declared surface as its target; the compiler writes the quad onto the target.

lives.note: embedPaint + paintEmbeddedPress + embedDark; projection kinetics/homography.mjs; row: the plate's layers.json must declare the surface

callable.why: probe OK; the plate must declare the surface

cards.title: The prop's moves after it lands

aliases.name: a prop moves after it lands

cards.does: After it lands the prop travels through authored keys - place, width, angle - on its own clock; keys with no gap glide through a Hermite chain, a gap stops it, and its hatched shadow rides the move.
cards.when: the sentence moves the object on after it has landed - it slides to the datum it now names, turns, or steps aside for the next thing (E99 s106 (2))

author.key: dock option {'prop': True, 'moves': [{at (s or a phrase of the take), x, y, w, rot, dur, ease}]}

phases.name: move
phases.does: each key moves the prop from where it stands to the key's box and angle over its dur, inheriting what the key does not name; a single move eases by min-jerk
phases.trigger: the key's `at` (seconds, or the first word of a phrase of the take)

phases.name: glide
phases.does: keys that follow with no gap are one path - a cubic Hermite chain passes through the middle key at speed; a gap between keys is a stop
phases.trigger: the next key's `at` equal to this key's end

options.means: Move ease: minimum jerk (the default, E45's park).

lives.note: engine propPose (a pure function of t) paints the keys the compiler's prop_moves writes as whole boxes

callable.why: any prop dock (5c6871c); a cold seek equals forward play; a move refused only when it cannot be played or seen

cards.title: The authored prop place

aliases.name: a prop goes where the author puts it

cards.does: A prop lands exactly where the row puts it - its painted centre and painted width as stage fractions, its height from the cutout's alpha - stamped, thrown or sprung; a stamp's ring and approach are drawn around that place.
cards.when: the author knows where the object belongs (a margin, beside the datum it names) and the fit's default room is wrong or too small; the fit's findings print as WARNs and the frame read judges (E99 s106)

options.means: The prop's resting angle in degrees; on a stamp it is the rotation spring's landing angle, and the fit turns the mark through it.

lives.note: the compiler honours the place (stamp_dock_place / prop_place_fit); with none, the fit reads the chart ON SCREEN at the landing (page_on_screen, R26-279)

callable.why: any prop dock (5c6871c); over data, over a label, cut by the frame or under the mark floor is a WARN with its numbers; only a place wholly off the stage is refused

cards.title: The read-then-park dock option
cards.does: A centred card first pops at a reading box, holds, then parks over a minimum-jerk layout move to its kept box beside the chart; its type scales with its width.
cards.when: a card that must be READ, then KEPT beside the chart

author.key: dock option {'centre': True, 'read': {centre_w, centre_x, centre_y, card_aspect}}

phases.name: pop
phases.does: the card pops at its reading box

phases.name: park
phases.does: shrinks and slides to its kept box on a minimum-jerk layout move

options.means: park_s: The park's length, in seconds (default DOCK_PARK_S).
read_s: The hold at the reading box, in seconds (default DOCK_READ_S).

callable.why: probe OK; on a stamp read/read_s/park_s are REPORTED as a WARN and not applied - a stamped prop is placed with place/moves (P69 T26d)

cards.title: The press pile
cards.does: Press cards flagged on one scene form a lit pile: the newest springs in while each older card is shoved one step back on a lean-and-squeeze pulse, fanning, shrinking and dimming; a card that leaves retracts and the pile closes.
cards.when: the stack when three claims land in a row

author.example: {"press": {"kind": "press", "source": "The Herald, 4 Mar 2026", "phrase": {"x0": 0.12, "y0": 0.2, "x1": 0.66, "y1": 0.44}, "phrase_text": "the historic normal was never normal", "card": [1056, 313]}, "stack": True}

phases.name: land
phases.does: the newest card springs down into the pile's box

phases.name: push
phases.does: every older card moves one step back, shoved sideways with a squeeze and a lean that return to zero
phases.trigger: the same enter, on a shorter clock

phases.name: settle (the fan)
phases.does: each step behind sits higher, smaller and dimmer, floored so a deep card is still a card

phases.name: underline
phases.does: the newest card's phrase is underlined as it is said

phases.name: retract
phases.does: a card past its exit retracts on the dock spring and the live count closes the gap

lives.note: pressStack / pressRest (law) + engine pressPile / pressPose; compiler assign_press_stack; row: each pile member a press dock

callable.why: probe: {'press': ..., 'stack': True} OK; {'stack': True} alone refused by name
